id.description: Reference number (e.g. 0000411581) or notice id (e.g. 444172273888). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,20}$.

kind.description:
Optional; inferred from the id length when absent (more than 10 digits = notice).

Provider reference: allowed values ["solicitation", "notice"].

url.description: A bidnetdirect.com solicitation or notice page URL; used when `id` is absent.

200.description:
One solicitation or notice detail page. Give `id` (the 10-digit reference number of a BidNet-hosted solicitation such as 0000411581, or the 12-digit id of an aggregated statewide/federal notice such as 444172273888; `kind` disambiguates ids of other lengths) or the detail page `url` from `search_solicitations`. Closed BidNet-hosted solicitations return the full public notice: reference number, issuing organization, type, solicitation number, source id, location, delivery point, piggyback flag, description, publication / question / closing dates, buyer contact, requirements, submission type, instructions and the NIGP and/or NAICS categories (one extra request). Open solicitations and notices are teasers: title, location, publication and closing dates (notices also an AI overview, closed notices also the description and the originating portal's `source_url`); fields the site shows to registered members only are null and named in `locked_fields`, with partial coverage. An unknown id is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

category_id.description:
NAICS-sector category id from `list_categories` (Construction 320204, Utilities 320179).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

content_group.description:
Restrict to bids published by BidNet member agencies, aggregated state & local notices, or federal notices.

Provider reference: allowed values ["member_agency", "state_local", "federal"].

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against the notice title and description.

location_id.description:
State / territory id from `list_locations` (Colorado 49, California 43, Alabama 19).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

page.description:
1-based page of 25 rows.

Provider reference: minimum 1; default 1.

publish_date.description:
Only solicitations published in the last 24 hours or the last week.

Provider reference: allowed values ["HOURS_24", "WEEK_1"].

sort_direction.description:
Uppercase only; the site answers HTTP 400 to lowercase values.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ASC", "DESC"].

status.description:
`open` (default) searches current bids; `closed` searches the historical archive.

Provider reference: allowed values ["open", "closed"]; default "open".

200.description:
Search BidNet Direct's open or closed solicitations through the public search controller (`/public/solicitations/{open|closed}`). Filters: `keywords`, `location_id` (state id from `list_locations`, e.g. 49 Colorado), `category_id` (NAICS-sector id from `list_categories`, e.g. 320204 Construction), `content_group` (member_agency | state_local | federal), `publish_date` (HOURS_24 | WEEK_1), `sort_by` and `sort_direction`. Pages hold 25 rows (the site ignores a page size); `page` selects one, `next_page` and the continuation say whether more follow. Each row carries the kind (`solicitation` = BidNet-hosted, 10-digit reference number; `notice` = aggregated statewide/federal notice, 12-digit id), title, state, content group, publication and closing dates and the detail URL `get_solicitation` accepts. A filter combination with no matches is a valid empty page with `total_results: 0`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `closing_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD; null when the row prints a placeholder such as `Not Available` instead of a date. |
| `detail_url` | string |  |
| `group` | string | `Member Agency Bids`, `State & Local Bids` or `Federal Bids` (the row icon's tooltip). |
| `id` | string | The reference number (solicitation) or notice id (notice) from the detail URL; what `get_solicitation` takes. |
| `internal_id` | string | The site's internal row id from the anchor; not accepted by the detail URL. |
| `kind` | string | `solicitation`: hosted on BidNet by a member agency; `notice`: aggregated from a state or federal portal. |
| `location` | string | State or territory name as printed. |
| `publication_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD; null when the row prints a placeholder such as `Not Available` instead of a date. |
| `state_slug` | string | First path segment of the detail URL (the state portal, e.g. `colorado`). |
| `time_remaining` | string | The site's `N day(s) left` text for open bids; null when not printed. |
| `title` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
